title: Calefaction
summary: CALEFACTION, noun 1. The act or operation of warming or heating; the production of heat in a body by the action of fire, or by the communication of heat from other bodies. 2. The state of being heated

inlines.v: CALEFACTION, noun 1. The act or operation of warming or heating; the production of heat in a body by the action of fire, or by the communication of heat from other bodies. 2. The state of being heated.
